trigger: TCS Q1 revenue contraction; renewed US tariff threats
magnitude: High/moderate negative: TCS revenue USD 7.421bn, -3.1% y/y constant currency.
reason: A large IT exporter's weak growth can downgrade sector expectations; higher blanket-tariff rhetoric adds risk despite record US equities.
timing: TCS official release 10 Jul; 11 Jul premarket digest corroborates before-session relevance.

trigger: Axis Bank Q1 asset-quality / provisioning concerns against positive global cues
magnitude: Moderate negative bank-specific earnings signal; US stocks at records positive offset.
reason: Higher credit costs or weak loan growth can reduce bank earnings expectations and affect financial-heavy NIFTY. Exact earnings surprise magnitude not established.
timing: 17 Jul earnings call; 18 Jul 07:42 IST outlook confirms positive global offset. Later stock decline not used as trigger.

trigger: US-Japan trade deal improved tariff sentiment
magnitude: High/moderate positive policy news; fresh agreement reduced uncertainty.
reason: A trade breakthrough can lift global risk appetite and hopes of further deals, supporting India despite its unresolved US talks.
timing: 23 Jul 08:06 IST report already discusses US-Japan agreement and early trading response.

trigger: Prior-day foreign selling opposed Infosys guidance upgrade / US rally
magnitude: Moderate mixed: FPI sales INR 4,209.11 crore; Infosys FY26 guidance 1%-3% vs 0%-3%.
reason: Outflows can pressure large caps, but better IT guidance and record US stocks support them. Negative close is not uniquely explained by these opposing signals.
timing: Infosys official release 23 Jul; morning digest gives 23 Jul flows. Exact digest publication time unverified.

trigger: Weak Asian cues / earnings valuation caution despite India-UK FTA
magnitude: Moderate negative/mixed; Asian equities lower, US mixed.
reason: Regional weakness and expensive valuations can reduce risk appetite; signing of UK trade agreement is an offsetting positive, not a negative trigger.
timing: 25 Jul 07:02 / 07:54 IST premarket reports; no unique economic surprise isolated.

trigger: Kotak earnings concern background; US-EU deal positive offset
magnitude: Moderate mixed: US-EU agreement set 15% tariff; GIFT flat at 07:30.
reason: Kotak weakness can depress banks, but Saturday results are outside Sunday window and US-EU deal supports risk appetite. No fresh negative shock established.
timing: Sunday 27 Jul US-EU agreement eligible; 26 Jul Kotak earnings older background. Do not use Monday stock fall as external event.

trigger: Weak morning cues and prior-day FPI outflows opposed positive close
magnitude: Moderate negative positioning: 28 Jul FPI sales INR 6,082.5 crore.
reason: Outflows normally weigh on valuations; rebound may be positioning-driven, but no positive external shock verified.
timing: 29 Jul 07:31 IST First Tick; morning digest reports 28 Jul flows.

trigger: US tariff-order repricing and weaker overnight equities
magnitude: High negative policy overhang: India 25% tariff announced previously; new country tariff schedule.
reason: Trade barriers threaten export margins and growth; overseas risk aversion can intensify foreign selling. India-specific initial announcement predates strict window, so incremental news must be distinguished.
timing: 1 Aug 08:22 IST First Tick and morning digest describe overnight tariff reaction; older India tariff treated as background.

trigger: Monday US futures recovery after weak prior week
magnitude: Moderate positive sentiment; prior Friday foreign selling INR 3,366 crore is negative background.
reason: Global futures rebound can support bargain buying after five losing weeks. No verified fresh Sunday economic surprise; older US jobs news cannot be labelled prior-day event.
timing: 4 Aug 07:34 IST outlook; morning digest describes fresh Monday US futures recovery.

trigger: Weak premarket risk appetite amid additional India tariff overhang
magnitude: High adverse background: additional 25% duty lifted total headline India tariff to 50%.
reason: Higher US import barriers threaten Indian exporters and portfolio flows. Announcement occurred 6 Aug, outside 7-8 Aug window; continuing repricing is plausible, not a new shock.
timing: 8 Aug 07:33 / 07:30 IST sources show weak morning cues; 6 Aug tariff announcement explicitly background.

trigger: Positive opening indications amid trade-negotiation hopes
reason: Modest global resilience / trade hopes may aid rebound, but no verified fresh agreement or positive external shock identified.
timing: Fortune 11 Aug 08:26 IST; NDTV later update includes 07:00 quote but not independently treated as publication proof.

trigger: US inflation report boosted September Fed-cut expectations
magnitude: Moderate positive global policy repricing; Wall Street and Asia higher.
reason: Less restrictive expected US policy can lower discount rates and favour EM flows; a plausible contributor to India gains.
timing: 13 Aug 07:23 IST report ties early Asian gains to 12 Aug US inflation.

trigger: GST reform / sovereign-rating upgrade optimism carried into Monday
magnitude: High positive policy background: S&P BBB from BBB-; proposed GST simplification.
reason: Lower consumption taxes can lift demand, while rating improvement may reduce risk premium. Original 15 Aug announcements lie outside strict Sunday window; fresh Monday GIFT strength is sentiment evidence only.
timing: 18 Aug 07:36 IST First Tick; 15 Aug policy/rating announcements treated as older background.

magnitude: Moderate negative/mixed; 21 Aug FPI buying INR 1,247 crore positive offset.
reason: Pre-speech uncertainty can encourage risk reduction, but no actual Powell guidance was known before Indian open; prior gains alone do not prove profit taking.
timing: 22 Aug 08:16 IST outlook; Jackson Hole speech later that day excluded.

trigger: Approaching additional India tariff effective date; overnight global weakness
magnitude: High negative overhang: 50% headline duty due 27 Aug; Asia ex-Japan around -0.2%.
reason: Imminent export barriers raise earnings and growth uncertainty; fresh global weakness can reinforce pre-expiry de-risking. Tariff announcement itself is older background.
timing: 26 Aug 07:28 IST outlook and overnight digest; event-day developments after 09:00 excluded.

trigger: Additional US India tariff took effect during Indian holiday
magnitude: High negative: total headline India duty 50%; US equities positive offset.
reason: Implementation raises near-term exporter costs and country risk despite supportive global equities; plausible direct domestic negative catalyst.
timing: 28 Aug 07:05 IST report; 27 Aug implementation within prior-day window, 27 Aug Indian market holiday.
